items.headline: 372-Unit Apartment Complex Permitted on Yoshino Way
items.summary: Permits were issued for 'Trimble B,' an apartment building at 120 Yoshino Way with a declared permit valuation of $66,319,496 and 372 source-reported dwelling units, along with a companion parking garage permit valued at $27,952,287.

items.headline: Eight ADU Permits Issued Across San José in Early October
items.summary: The feed lists 8 ADU permits issued between October 1 and October 5, covering detached, attached, garage-conversion, and junior ADU types with declared valuations ranging from about $65,970 to $483,014.
